rules.description: Strip standard Arabic short vowel diacritics (Harakat) because CTC models recognize graphemes (consonants + long vowels) rather than vocalic diacritics.
Remove special Quranic annotation signs (Waqf stops, Sajdah, Hizb, and elongation guides) which have no acoustic expression and do not belong to the vocal dictionary.
Convert Alif Khanjariya (Superscript/Dagger Alif, representing a long 'a' vowel) to a standard Alif letter, preserving phonetic length in the text representation.
Convert Alif Waslah (representing an elided Alif at word boundaries) to a standard Alif to match tokenizer graphemic inputs.
Map all variations of Alif (Alif with Hamza above, Alif with Hamza below, Alif Maddah) to a simple bare Alif to match the model's unified Alif token.
Map Ta Marbouta to Ha to align with typical Arabic CTC tokenizers that collapse this distinction acoustically.
Map Alif Maqsura (Ya without dots) to standard Alif or Ya depending on context, typically collapsed to Alif or Ya in the target vocab.

During normalization, for every single character retained in the normalized output, a mapping object is generated containing: {canonical_word_idx, char_in_word_idx, canonical_word}. This allows the CTC alignment outputs on normalized tokens to be perfectly mapped back to the exact index and bounds of the original Uthmani word.
